content:
It was June 5 when @Anne Baanen's PR with convert(!) was merged: #rss > Recent Commits to mathlib4:master @ 💬.
I just want to record here that I've been reviewing a bunch of PRs recently that are using convert (without !) and I just feel a lot more comfy now reviewing them simply on GH. No need to open the PR in VS Code to check if something nasty is happening under the hood.
I still look forward to the big PR converting (no pun intend) many convert!s into converts, when this just works :-)
I was going to make an inspirational message pointing out how you can help by merging #40663 but it seems this is finally moving forward! :)
Once #40663 is in, I will resurrect #39039 and drastically reduce the amount of screaming per convert
